subject: POC timeline & milestone slate — Quantix evaluation
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@quantix.ai>, Katie Miller <katie@quantix.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: Quantix discovery + proposed POC milestones

Hi Samir / Katie —

Thanks again for the hour today. Quick recap and a concrete next-steps proposal so we can lock the kickoff date: 

Recap (from our call)
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for Quantix’s real-time summarization pipeline at 99ms median token latency and <2% quality delta vs your current baseline.
- Data: You’ll provide 2 sample streams (prod-like) and a small labeled eval set (~150 examples) for quality checks.
- Success criteria we agreed: latency under 120ms median at target concurrency, summary ROUGE-L within 2 pts of baseline, and no PII leakage in summaries.

Proposed POC milestone slate (high level) — attached spreadsheet has same plan:
1) Kickoff & environment access (Week 0) — Infra prep, access to one test topic stream, and confirmation of metrics collection.
2) Integration & smoke tests (Week 1) — run sample traffic, validate tokens/stats, measure baseline latency.
3) Eval run & quality checks (Weeks 2–3) — run labeled evals, iterate prompt tuning and quantization profile.
4) Scale test & cost modeling (Week 4) — ramp to target concurrency, produce per-token cost estimate.
5) Final readout (Week 5) — results deck, decision rubric, and recommended next steps.

Owners:
- Redwood: me (PM/eng liaison), Ben (solutions eng — infra + perf), Soojin (integration + eval harness)
- Quantix: Samir (eng lead), Katie (product)

What we need from you to finalize kickoff:
- Confirm the kickoff week you prefer (we are proposing Mon 1 Mar 2027 but can shift)
- Share the two sample streams and the labeled eval set via the Drive link or S3 access; we flagged exact paths in the attached Quantix_POC_requirements.xlsx
- Sign off on the milestone slate in the attached Redwood_POC_milestones_v2.xlsx — we can take any edits inline.

Attachments: Quantix_POC_requirements.xlsx, Redwood_POC_milestones_v2.xlsx

If that all looks good I’ll get calendar invites and a short kickoff agenda out today.

Thanks —
Ava Chen
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Samir Patel <samir@quantix.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Katie Miller <katie@quantix.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 18:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Quantix discovery + proposed POC milestones

Ava — thanks for the clear note and the timeline. This aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Kickoff week: 1 Mar 2027 works for Samir + Katie; our engineering calendar has a release window the following week (8 Mar) so having the bulk of integration in Weeks 1–3 is ideal.
- Sample streams: I will upload two anonymized streams to the Drive folder you shared by EOD Monday (22 Feb). The labeled eval set (150 examples) will follow by Wed.
- Success criteria: We’re comfortable with the latency and quality thresholds but want an explicit check that any prompt tuning or quantization changes are reversible (we need to be able to map outputs back to baseline model behavior).

Also attaching our internal stakeholder list: 
- Priya R. (Data infra) — will own S3 access and dataset handoff (I’ll loop her in after we confirm kickoff)
- Omar (Security) — will need the compliance questionnaire; can you send the SOC2 evidence packet and retention policy?

We’d like the SOW draft before kickoff if possible — Katie is happy to review. Can you route the MUP_SOW_draft.pdf over?

Thanks — Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Engineering, Quantix
samir@quantix.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@quantix.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Quantix discovery + proposed POC milestones

Looping in a few technical notes so expectations are clear on our side: 

- Integration surface: We support both HTTP-based streaming and gRPC. For this POC we recommend gRPC for lower tail latency; if Quantix prefers HTTP we’ll keep batching small to preserve median latency.
- KV cache & prefix tuning: To hit 100–120ms median at modest concurrency we’ll propose a small KV cache window (32 steps) and a conservative quantization profile (int8 dynamic). We’ll test int8/static and compare quality delta.
- Eval harness: Soojin will run the labeled eval and produce side-by-side output diffs and per-example ROUGE-L. We’ll include a change-log so Samir’s team can replay any tuning steps.

I’ll add a short technical appendix to the SOW draft that lists supported endpoint configs and the replay/rollback plan for prompt/quantization changes.

Attachments: draft appendix (I’ll add to the MUP_SOW_draft.pdf in the Drive)

— Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0189

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@quantix.ai>, Katie Miller <katie@quantix.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Quantix discovery + proposed POC milestones

Thanks Ben — adding your appendix now. Samir / Katie: I uploaded an updated Redwood_POC_milestones_v2.xlsx (tabbed with owners and dates) and a short kickoff agenda to the Drive link in the related links. Key changes per Ben’s note: 

- Explicit rollback plan included as Appendix A.
- Added stove-pipe test the week of 1 Mar that runs a single-topic stream at 2x your expected token rate (safety margin).
- Added a security pre-check with Omar: we’ll provide SOC2 artifacts and a retention policy snapshot; Omar should get the file in the Drive once Samir confirms we may share the artifacts with Quantix contacts.

Proposed calendar items (I will calendar-in when you confirm):
- Kickoff (30 min) — Mon, 1 Mar 2027 10:00–10:30 PT — introductions + environment checklist
- Weekly check-in (30 min) — recurring on Mondays 10:00–10:30 PT (Weeks 1–4)
- Final readout (45 min) — Fri, 5 Apr 2027 10:00–10:45 PT (presentation + decision rubric)

If those slots work I’ll send invites and include an initial list of artifacts we’ll deliver each week.

Attachments: Redwood_POC_milestones_v2.xlsx (updated), kickoff_agenda.docx (brief)

Regards,
Ava

From: Samir Patel <samir@quantix.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Katie Miller <katie@quantix.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Feb 2027 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Quantix discovery + proposed POC milestones

Ava — all looks good on our side. Confirming the calendar slots: kickoff 1 Mar 2027 10:00 PT and weekly Mondays at 10:00 PT. Final readout on 5 Apr 2027 works for leadership (I’ll reserve time).

I’ve asked Priya R. to provide S3 paths by Monday and will loop Omar once you upload the SOC2 artifacts. Katie asked that we get the SOW this week so she can redline ahead of kickoff — please send the MUP_SOW_draft.pdf and your appendix.

One procedural note: for any prompt tuning steps that materially change aggregate summary length we want a short experiment plan logged in the Drive with the seed prompts we used; Ben, will you take that on?

Thanks, team — excited to get started.

Samir
